responses.text: Don't bother me right now. I've got to get back to see if any customers are waiting.
Stay away from me, if you know what's good for you.
Come on, let's get this over with.
Don't distract me. I need to focus all my senses on keeping you safe.
This gentleman and I were just settling on a price. I'm afraid you'll have to hire one of the others this time around.
If you need to cross Freeside, no one will keep you safer than I will.
I knew you'd be back. Ready to hire the best?
Nothing to worry about. If you had hired one of those other hacks, you'd be up to your ass in lowlife right about now.
So tell me, did you really think I'd be stupid enough to fall for this again? One of my men saw you go in and out of the Kings' place.
As much as I hate to lose a customer, it's just unavoidable sometimes.
Just look around. People here are as like to stab you as say hello. That is, if I weren't at your side.

topics.prompt: Why do I need a bodyguard crossing Freeside?

responses.text: Two hundred caps gets you my watchful eye for a trip to the south gate.
Sorry, but all the people with real money are heading for the Strip, so that's the way I go. You want to go somewhere else, hire one of these losers.

topics.prompt: What if I'm not going to the south gate?

responses.text: I'm sure Freeside will disabuse you of that notion soon enough. Farewell.

topics.prompt: I don't think I need your services. Sorry.

responses.text: Done and done. I want to mention a few things up front. In order to ensure your safety, I need you to follow my instructions to the letter.
We'll be heading down the main street here the whole way down. No detours. You go off sightseeing and I go off to find another customer.
I'll keep a brisk pace, so try not to fall behind. Now let's head out.
Hey, you want the best, you have to pay for it.

topics.prompt: Two hundred caps! That's twice what everyone else is charging!

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] Er, noticed that, did you? I keenly aimed one of the shots through some soft tissue of one of them to hit the man behind him.

topics.prompt: Hey you only fired three shots and there are four guys there...
topics.label: {Intelligence check > 5}

responses.text: [FAILED] You're imagining things. It's just the rush of adrenaline caused by your near brush with death.
Luckily for you, I was here, so there's no reason to get out of sorts.

topics.prompt: Something about this doesn't seem right...
topics.label: {Intelligence check > 5}

responses.text: Call it a hunch. You do this job for long enough, and you learn to trust your instincts.

topics.prompt: Why did you run ahead like that?

responses.text: My thoughts exactly. Time is money, after all.
That's an interesting theory you've got there. I'd suggest you keep it to yourself. Let's get moving.

topics.prompt: Or, you just faked this whole thing to drum up repeat business.

responses.text: Stay close. I wouldn't want something to happen to you.
[SUCCEEDED] I ought to take my chances and kill you right here, but you may be right. Here, take this.
Don't think this is over, though. I'll have that money back, out of your hide if I have to.

topics.prompt: I want all the money you have on you. I could make it to the Kings from here.
topics.label: {Barter check >= 50}

responses.text: [FAILED] I think I'll keep my money thanks. You take that fanciful tale of yours wherever you'd like. Now let's go. I have a job to finish.

topics.prompt: You should give me all your money. Or I'll tell. And stuff.
topics.label: {Barter check >= 50}

responses.text: You want the best, you have to be prepared to pay for it.

topics.prompt: I don't have that kind of money.

responses.text: To your left here is the Old Mormon Fort. You get roughed up, the Followers there will patch you right up. Not that I ever need their services.
Up ahead on the next block is where the Kings hang out. Don't let them scare you, if they don't outnumber you five to one you'll be fine.
Down to the right here is the fun part of town. You haven't seen Freeside till you've been to the Wrangler.
It's regrettable, but it looks like I'm about to lose another customer.
You idiot! What part of "play dead" do you not understand?
Well, here we are. No worse for wear, are you? I trust that if you need to cross Freeside again, you'll know who to hire.
Well, here we are. I trust you'll keep your mouth shut about the topic we were just discussing, or else.
That was rather invigorating, wasn't it? Let's keep moving, it's only a little further to the gate.
Gotcha! Thought you could ambush us, huh?
Leave them to me!
Just so you know, heading out here breaks our contract. This is why I ask people to pay up front. See you around.
You don't follow orders very well, do you? Oh well, more money for me.
Hmmm, I guess they were harmless after all. I'm not often mistaken, you know.
I'll scout ahead. You follow at a distance.
Hey, slow down. I don't like the look of some of those men ahead. Let's take a different way around.
